model_annotation: The image displays three donut charts comparing enterprises, employment, and net turnover by industry, construction, trade, and services in 2021, based on NACE Rev. 2 data. The first chart, "NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES," shows four sectors: Industry (8%, 2.4 million), Construction (12%, 3.7 million), Trade (19%, 5.9 million), and Other Services (61%, 19.0 million), with the sectors visually ordered by size from smallest to largest. The second chart, "NUMBER OF PERSONS EMPLOYED," presents data for Industry (21%, 33.0 million), Construction (9%, 13.4 million), Trade (19%, 29.5 million), and Other Services (51%, 80.2 million), arranged in descending order of percentage. The third chart, "TURNOVER," shows Industry (33%, 10.6 trillion), Construction (6%, 1.9 trillion), Trade (31%, 9.9 trillion), and Other Services (31%, 9.8 trillion), with the sectors ordered by percentage. Each chart includes a legend that identifies the color associated with each sector: Industry (yellow), Construction (light blue), Trade (red), and Other Services (dark blue). The percentages and absolute values are displayed within each segment of the donut charts.
